note.title: Improved constant for [BSSZ2026]
note.author: Ingo Althoefer
note.theorem: "there are arbitrarily large finite sets A ⊂ R such that max(|A+A|,|AA|) ≤ |A|^{2-0.0007}. The optimized value suggested by the same calculation is about 0.000719, but 0.0007 is the safer quoted constant."
